title: Product proof index
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $i$ be an index with $0\le i<m$. The product proof index is the image of $i$ in the first block of the disjoint union of an $m$-element set and an $(m+1)$-element set, identified with an index from $0$ to $2m$.
